result.topic_en: The opening of a personal letter dated Göttingen, 26 April 1857 (year reading uncertain), addressed to 'Meine liebe Helene', with faint, inverted pencil writing at the bottom that is not mathematical and is largely illegible.
result.transcription:
Göttingen, den 26. April 1857[?]

Meine liebe Helene[?]!

Du wirst aus meinen Briefen an Wilhelm[?] ersehen, wie es mir hier
jetzt geht

[faint pencil writing, inverted/show-through, largely illegible:]
... [?]
... [?]
